in_sanskrit.name: प्राणेश
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who is the lord of Prana (Life), the vital force or energy that is responsible for sustaining life. This name is derived from the Sanskrit words 'prana' meaning life and 'ish' meaning lord.

in_hindi.name: प्राणेश
in_hindi.long_meaning: Prana ke Ishwar, meaning the Lord of Prana (Life).

in_tamil.name: பிரநேஷ
in_tamil.long_meaning: The one who is the Lord of Prana (Life).

in_telugu.name: ప్రానేశ
in_telugu.long_meaning: The one who is the Lord of Prana (Life).

in_marathi.name: Pranesh
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of Creation
in_marathi.long_meaning: Pranesh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Pranesh is a Sanskrit name derived from the Sanskrit word Prana, which means 'life' or 'breath'. The suffix -esh denotes 'lord' or 'master'. This name signifies the lord or master of creation, and is often given to a baby as a symbol of the belief that he or she is a divine being.
